slides.label: The slide
slides.text: The Nasdaq-100 hit a record in October, then AI and chip stocks fell about *10%* from their peak.

slides.label: Rates
slides.text: Fed Governor *Waller* backed a *December hike*. The Fed meets *Dec 8 and 9*.

slides.label: Mortgages
slides.text: Freddie Mac's 30-year averaged *7.18%* on Nov 5, vs *6.22%* a year earlier.

slides.label: Nov 17
slides.text: *Nvidia* reports: the biggest date for AI sentiment before year-end.

slides.label: Your move
slides.text: *Don't panic-sell.* Check your *concentration*. Keep cash working in *T-bills*.

cta_line: Volatility is loud. *A plan is quiet.*
